messages:
amir: FYI I'm drafting the official deprecation note for the old /models endpoint and the v1->v2 model name mapping. Product wants to publish next week so docs+SDKs need alignment.

lucy: thanks for the heads up. do we have a canonical mapping table yet? customers keep asking which v2 model corresponds to `redwood-medium` etc.

amir: initial mapping proposal: `redwood-small` -> `rw-sm-1`, `redwood-medium` -> `rw-md-1`, `redwood-large` -> `rw-lg-1` and `redwood-instruct` -> `rw-instruct-1` (in some cases choose `-quant` variants for cost). I'll add caveats about tokenization differences.

rachel: can you add an explicit migration snippet for the SDKs? The breaking change is that the `model` param in v1 client was a free string; in v2 we want `model_id` and we recommend pinning to a major.minor (e.g., `rw-md-1@2025-01`) for stability.

amir: good call. Draft JS snippet:```js
// v1
const res = client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', prompt: '...', max_tokens: 128 })

// v2 migration
const res = client.generate({ model_id: 'rw-md-1@2025-01', input: '...', max_tokens: 128 })
```

lucy: add a short note about embeddings endpoint too 15 some customers used model name interchangeably across generation/embeddings. For embeddings recommend `rw-embed-1` family.

rachel: also flag the quota and rate-limit differences for dedicated customers when swapping to quantized variants. That has bitten a couple of accounts.

amir: noted. I'll add a compatibility section: "When switching to `*-quant` models latency improves and cost drops, but throughput per-GPU may change; contact sales for capacity adjustments."

lucy: docs team: can we include a small script to auto-rewrite codebases? Something simple that replaces `model:\s*'redwood-[^']+'` with `model_id: '<mapping>'` in JS/TS code. Might save customers time.

amir: good idea — I'll include a sample grep+sed one-liner and a small Python refactor script in a gist.

rachel: reviewers? I can review the migration text for accuracy. Tom can check the SDK examples and ensure the TS types reflect `model_id`.

tom: I'll update the TypeScript client typings in a follow-up PR. Heads-up: we renamed `listModels()` response schema too (fields moved) so example JSONs in the docs need updating.

amir: can we schedule a brief sync tomorrow with eng-ml so we don't accidentally recommend models that are going EOL?

lucy: yes, I'll ping @eng-ml and add the meeting to the calendar.

docs-bot: docs preview queued at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/model-deprecation-mapping (build will post comment when ready).

amir: ETA for docs PR: opening in ~2 hours. I'll mark as "docs: migration + code snippets" and include the mapping table, SDK example changes (JS/TS/Py), and sed script link.

rachel: thanks. one more: please add a short troubleshooting list for common migration errors (401 on pinned models, model not found, tokenization drift notes). Saves us triage time.

amir: will do. tagging the thread once PR is up.

tom: thanks all, will watch the PR and update types after the docs land.

lucy: great work 14 :shipit:

rachel: thanks everyone.
